response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT execution_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS total_execution_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share
